### STAGE ONE: Install and set up the tmux env

1. Install the tmux
  sudo apt install tmux

2. Start a named station
  tmux new -s download

3. Move into the right dir and activate the virtual env
  cd /exports/st18
  source ~/DeltaMut-Database/ARP_Download_Files/DataverseMassUploader/.venv/bin/activate

4. Proxy issue fix
  env | grep -i proxy

5. Re-export the same host and port with http:// instead of https://:
  export https_proxy=http://host:port
  export HTTPS_PROXY=http://host:port

6. Verify the working dir and the available space before continuing
  pwd
  df -h .
  curl -sS -m 20 https://repo.researchdata.hu | head -c 100; echo

7. Star the download with a log file
  cut -f3 private_urls.tsv | xargs -n1 bash download_private.sh 2>&1 | tee -a download.log

### STAGE TWO: Check the downloading

1. Detach and let it run
  Press Ctrl+B, then D. You're back to a normal prompt, and the download keeps running in the background, surviving disconnects.

2. Check the downloading at anytime: Reconnect to the VM (from a new SSH connection, or the same one later), then:

  tmux attach -t download
  tmux ls
  tail -f /exports/st18/download.log
  df -h /exports/st18
  find /exports/st18 -name .done | wc -l
